children: Dave & Buster reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $544.1 million, a 2.4% decline versus the prior-year quarter, and an adjusted EBITDA of $98.9 million. The company recorded a GAAP net loss of $12.5 million, or $(0.36) per diluted share, and an adjusted net loss of $9.5 million, or $(0.27) per diluted share. Available liquidity was $492.1 million and adjusted free cash flow for the six months ended August 4, 2026 was positive $19.5 million.
Revenue: $544.1 million for the quarter ended August 4, 2026 (down 2.4% year-over-year).
Adjusted EBITDA: $98.9 million for the quarter (non-GAAP).
Operating income: $19.4 million for the quarter.
Net loss (GAAP): $(12.5) million, or $(0.36) per diluted share for the quarter; Adjusted net loss (non-GAAP): $(9.5) million, or $(0.27) per diluted share.
Liquidity and cash flow: $492.1 million of available liquidity; Adjusted free cash flow of $19.5 million for the six months ended August 4, 2026.
Comparable store sales decreased 2.9% versus the same calendar period in fiscal 2025; remodelled stores continued to outperform the system.
Opened six new domestic stores in Q2; expect two additional Dave & Buster’s remodels to be completed during the remainder of fiscal 2026 (eight total remodels for fiscal 2026).
International franchising progress: six international franchise stores currently open and at least one additional international franchise store expected to open before fiscal year-end.

Reported ongoing growth in food and beverage sales and in Special Events sales; management noted improvement in overall same-store sales in July and continued improvement in the third quarter to date.
